Placement.description:
Where a free standing object sits on the frame. Give at most one of `at`, `edge` or
`next_to`; with none of them the object is centred. `shift` then nudges it.

In a file, `place: top` is short for `place: {edge: top}`, and `place: [1, 2]` for
`place: {at: [1, 2]}`.

at.description: Position of the object's centre, in frame units
at.title: At

edge.description: Push the object against an edge or corner of the frame
edge.title: Edge

next_to.description: Put the object beside another one
next_to.title: Next To

side.description: Which side of `next_to` to put it on
side.title: Side

buff.description: Gap left against the edge, or against `next_to`
buff.title: Buff

shift.description: Moved by this much afterwards, in frame units
shift.title: Shift
